title: Understanding Intraday Momentum Strategies
one_line: Intraday momentum predictability disappears in the out-of-sample period; a Markov-switching model finds two regimes, and predictability depends on signal strength — calendar-time tests can mislead when anomalies have time-varying returns.

findings.statement: Two regimes; predictability depends on the strength of the signal.

why.pattern: Regime-dependent momentum (works in strong-signal / volatile regimes).

reported_results.headline: Intraday momentum gone out of sample, except in strong-signal regimes.

tradable_edge: Warning for noise_area_last_half_hour_es and Dual Noise Zone: test strength-dependence (dose-response by band distance) and regimes, not just the unconditional average.
data_fit: ES 1-min Dec 2013 → Sep 2026, NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026 (2024+ protected in the backtest project).
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 2), not by the weekly pipeline.
